title: One common threshold under unequal starting distributions
purpose: Quantify the equal-opportunity gap produced by one common raw-score threshold as the starting-distribution gap (delta) and measurement-noise ratio (rho) vary
primary_outcome: EOG = TPR_A - TPR_B (pp); primary contrast delta=0.5 vs delta=0 at rho=1
status: run complete 2026-11-25 (240/240 ok, revision b455d59); H1 supported; report pending (coordinator)
planned_analysis: Mean paired difference over 20 seeds; 95% percentile bootstrap over seeds; SESOI 2 pp; analytic cross-check

title: Comparing equal and constrained rules; incompatible criteria
purpose: Compare P0 to P3 on group gaps and utility; test whether any rule meets selection-rate parity and equal opportunity and predictive parity together when starting distributions differ
primary_outcome: Whether all three criteria hold within 2 pp per policy at delta=0.5 rho=1 (and at the control)
status: run complete 2026-11-25 (960/960 ok, revision b455d59); H1 and H2 supported; report pending (coordinator)
planned_analysis: Seed-mean gaps with bootstrap intervals; paired utility differences versus P0

title: Sensitivity: base rate versus distribution shape
purpose: Test whether the EXP-001 gap is a base-rate effect or a distribution-shape effect; vary latent dispersion and family; capacity; group share
primary_outcome: EOG at equal base rates and its sign at a fixed base-rate gap
status: run complete 2026-11-25 (420/420 ok, revision b455d59); H0 rejected, H2 sign reversal as analytically determined, H3 and H4 sign kept; implementation check 56/60 within 3 SE (deviation DEC-019); report pending (coordinator)
planned_analysis: Seed-mean EOG with bootstrap intervals; sign stability across cells

title: Second test on a real score distribution (UCI Adult)
purpose: Test whether the equal-opportunity gap predicted by the synthetic mechanism appears under one common threshold on a real score and label (UCI Adult test file; partition hours-per-week below 40 versus a random-permutation control; no protected attribute used)
depends_on: EXP-001 pipeline; UCI Adult (EXT-001); score model JRN-0005
primary_outcome: D = EOG(R-hours, P0) - EOG(R-hours-random, P0) (pp), paired by seed; SESOI 2 pp
status: run complete 2026-11-25 (160/160 ok, revision b455d59); H1-real disconfirmed (D negative); report pending (coordinator)
planned_analysis: Mean paired difference over 20 seeds; 95% percentile bootstrap over seeds; SESOI 2 pp; split-variability caveat; no analytic check
